describe.title: Explicit shard grants for the bundle reader

components.name: meta-store
components.role: catalog of table columns across databases, with per-principal grants

components.name: bundle-builder
components.role: runs as svc_bundle_reader; reads column metadata for bundle_fields and writes a bundle file

components.name: worker-runtime
components.role: loads the bundle file at startup

change.title: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader
change.description: Moves the reader's implicit access to shard databases onto explicit grants so that per-principal query limits and audit logging apply.
change.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/migrations/0042_reader_shard_grants.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+-- Make the reader's access to shard databases explicit so per-principal
+-- query limits and audit logging apply to it.
+GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader;
+GRANT SELECT ON r1.* TO svc_bundle_reader;

setup.base_sql: GRANT SELECT ON default.* TO svc_bundle_reader;
setup.revert_sql:
REVOKE SELECT ON r0.* FROM svc_bundle_reader;
REVOKE SELECT ON r1.* FROM svc_bundle_reader;
